# Category icons — the curated Lucide set.
#
# One glyph per line; `#` starts a comment. `scripts/gen-icons.mjs` reads this
# file, takes each name's path data out of the pinned `lucide-static` package and
# writes `src/lib/icons/generated.ts`. The generated file is committed, so the
# build never needs the package and never needs the network.
#
# The order matters: it is the tie-break in `guessIcon`, so a category keeps the
# same glyph across runs. Add a name at the end rather than in the middle when
# the only reason is "another glyph would be nice".
